name: Best Tort Lawyers

seo.description: Tell Sofia what happened in your own words. Best Tort Lawyers helps identify whether you may potentially qualify for further claim review and the type of legal team that may fit.
seo.title: Best Tort Lawyers — Start With Sofia

facebook.bio: A clearer first step for serious claims. Tell Sofia what happened and find out whether you may potentially qualify for further review.

instagram.bio: A clearer first step for serious claims. Start with Sofia.

youtube.bio: Best Tort Lawyers — clear information about serious tort claims and a guided first step with Sofia.

tagline: A clearer first step for serious claims.

assistant.name: Sofia
assistant.greeting: Hi, I'm Sofia. Tell me what happened in your own words — you can keep it general.
assistant.persona_notes: Plain, direct, human. Never promises outcomes, never gives legal advice, never cites win rates or dollar figures. Say 'potentially qualify' — never 'you qualify.' Warm, unhurried, one question at a time. If someone wants a human, offer the phone path.
assistant.voice_first_message: Hi, this is Sofia with Best Tort Lawyers. Tell me what happened in your own words and I'll help identify the right next step.
